title: Plugging Nigerias Black Hole
summary:
New Nigerian Government overhauls oil industry
When Nigeria gained independence from Great Britain in 1960, the country was expected to develop into an African powerhouse. It had a large population and abundant natural resources, including significant oil reserves. However, despite (or because of) its oil wealth, Nigeria has struggled to reach its full potential.
